sources.title: Imperial Gazetteer of India, second edition, volume X: Mysore, printed page 95
sources.note: Direct transcription of original official gazetteer: 1799 restoration, assumption of administration 1831, adoption and succession 1868, rendition 25 March 1881. Colonial verdicts on misgovernment and efficiency not adopted. Entire volume treated as one work.

sources.title: Sethur Rao S.: Centenary of Karnataka Assembly, Yojana, October 1981
sources.note: Official indexed original article recovered by exact title/Veeravalli search, including Origin and March 25/October 7,1881 passages. Original old PDF URL failed; both publication URLs grouped. No superlative first-in-Asia electricity or modern democracy claim adopted.

sources.title: Lewis Rice: Mysore and Coorg, volume I, Mysore in General (1877)
sources.note: Full original public-domain OCR downloaded as rice 1877.txt. Printed pp.357 dwellings,agricultural year 1874-75 immediately before Administration,614 post,645 night schools,648 hospital. All descriptions dated to compilation or specific years; racist/caste stereotypes excluded. No borrowing from Buchanan agricultural chapters.

sources.title: Aditya Ramesh: Flows and fixes: water, disease and housing in Bangalore,1860 to 1915
sources.note: Direct original research article, online 2021, Urban History 52(2025),118-140. Use pp.124,127-129 only, within atlas or explicit 1870s crisis. Colonial medical allegations and actual modern disease knowledge distinguished; no adoption of racial sanitation blame.

sources.title: Digital Ludeme Project: Mysore Tiger Game (Two Tigers), DLP 967
sources.note: Original academic project indexed text and linked evidence 1826 read in full. Vasantha 2006 pp.30-31; manuscripts of Krishnaraja Wadiyar III. Evidence dates 1794-1868 reflect ruler lifetime, not exact manuscript year; do not imply contemporary universal child play.

sources.title: R. H. Campbell Tufnell: Catalogue of Mysore Coins, Government Museum Bangalore (1889)
sources.note: Public-domain government catalogue downloaded; title PDFpage 6 and printedp 59/PDFpage 62 visually inspected. Entry 292:1833 twenty-cash coin, Kannada Krishna, Persian struck-at-Mysore wording, Kannada denomination and MILAY XXCASH. Kannada sample visually verified, modern Unicode transcription of printed reading rather than reconstructed glyph shapes.

sources.title: Government handbook: Mysore State, Education, printed page 45
sources.note: Original institutional digitization indexed page 45 recovered by Maharaja/1833 query. Direct URL 404, recorded access limitation. School 1833; takeover 1868; affiliation 1879. No assumption college building 1889 existed during atlas period.

sources.title: Bowring Institute: institutional history
sources.note: Organization’s indexed original history: Literary and Scientific Institute 1868 on Museum Road; present-site grant 1888 and buildinglater. Direct tool fetch failed; indexed full text used. Conflicting 1887/1888 building dates avoided.

sources.title: R. P. Jackson: Coin Collecting in Mysore, British Numismatic Journal 5 (1908)
sources.note: Direct original first-person numismatic report, openingpp.289-290/PDFpages 1-2:1890 arrival and village purchases; people asking whether official currency exchange; old Mysore mintage ceased 1843. Racist judgments omitted; later collecting not presented as atlas-period event.

sources.title: IGNCA: Overview of Karnataka State Archives cataloguing and digitization
sources.note: Original indexed institutional list: Mysore Government proceedings 1843-1961, gazettes 1866-1947, commissioners’ documents 1832-1881 and Modi/Marathi/Persian manuscripts. Direct fetch failed. Used solely for surviving records, no claim about contents of particular unread files.
